Current POC context: reranking + chat + personalized search. Primary ask: dedicated GPU pool with predictable throughput so product teams can commit to response-time SLAs. Target SLOs: chat 95th <= 120ms (token-latency optimized), reranking end-to-end <= 250ms, throughput sustained 450-600 req/s across peak sharding. Learned from infra run: KV cache and prefix caching reduce token work by ~27% on replay. CTO quote: 'We need guarantees — if tails blow up we lose conversion.'

Model-specific tuning notes (from SE session):
- Model candidates: Llama-2-70B-int8 / Mistral-Instruct-34B / Redwood-verified 70B-optim. Evaluate context lens: 8k vs 32k for session-based personalization. 32k gives better UX but increases memory footprint ~2.8x; requires multi-GPU sharding planning.
- Quantization profile: prefer q4f16 for cost/quality tradeoff but want a safety run on q8_0 to measure hallucination/regression. Need kernel validation for q4f16 on customer's on-prem infer nodes (they will test a pilot in their EU data center).
- Batching/KV-cache: prefer continuous batching window 5-10ms for chat to keep latency low; enable per-route small-batch fast-path for high-QPS reranking. Recommend aggressive prefix/KV caching for session reuse; initial config reduced tokens by ~27% in replay.
- Reserved GPU planning: preliminary sizing suggests 8 x 80GB A100 for peak with headroom for spikes; alternate plan: 12 x 40GB with NVLink sharding for 32k contexts. Discussed burst lanes for holiday peak.

Operational/security asks: SSO/SAML integration is required; retention controls for logs; audit logs forwarded to their SIEM; EU data residency for EU customers; HSM/KMS integration for keys. Pricing sensitivity: prefer blended reserved commitment (12–24 months) with rollover credits for burst.
